changelog:
Initial release of "Generate Facebook Ad Creative Variations" skill.

- Creates multiple Facebook ad copy and image variations tailored to distinct audiences and placements.
- Ideal for marketers, agencies, and growth teams setting up paid ad campaigns.
- Guides users to clarify campaign goals and constraints before generating ad content.
- Supports generation and refinement of ad copy and creative assets for A/B testing.
- Integrates with chat and image generation APIs.
summary: Generates multiple Facebook ad copy and image variations optimized for diverse audiences and placements to support campaign setup and A/B testing.
